contributes.instructions: Pasting HTML on the canvas (Cmd+V with markup as plain text, or text/html that is more than a single paragraph of prose; a paragraph copied from a page lands as canvas text through the Text plugin instead) lands it as one new daydream.viewport item, 960px wide and selected: the fragment's element structure, text, inline style attributes and its class, id and data-* attributes are kept; every style block, in head or body, lands as the viewport's sheet — the flat rules the browser parses, nesting flattened, @media, @container and @supports ancestry as conditions, !important stripped and counted, @font-face lifted into fonts — while @import, @layer, @keyframes and @property are counted and lost; a tag the format cannot hold becomes a span (phrasing content) or a div; every other attribute, linked stylesheets, scripts and embedded content are dropped; a data: image is vendored, an https: image stays, any other image source is dropped with the img kept. No gates run on a paste; the console reports what was lost. A paste of more than 10,000 elements or four million characters is refused and lands nothing; past 64 levels of nesting an element lands as a leaf holding its words.
